talents.name: Improved Tracking

ranks.description: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 1%.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Replaces Humanoid/Monster Slaying tier-1 slot area on Forever overview.

talents.name: Deflection

ranks.description: Increases your Parry chance by 2%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Deflection rank 1 (+2% Parry) and maxRank 5.

talents.name: Entrapment

ranks.description: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 1 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Entrapment rank 1 text and maxRank 5.

talents.name: Savage Strikes

ranks.description: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 2%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Savage Strikes rank 1 (all melee +2% crit) and maxRank 2.

talents.name: Survivalist

ranks.description: Increases your total Health by 2%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Survivalist rank 1 (+2% total Health) and maxRank 5. Forever moved to row3 col1 (Classic row2 col1).

talents.name: Improved Wing Clip

ranks.description: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 7% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Improved Wing Clip rank 1 (7%) and maxRank 3.

talents.name: Clever Traps

ranks.description: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 15% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 15%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Clever Traps rank 1 text and maxRank 2.

talents.name: Surefooted

ranks.description: Increases your hit chance by 1% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Surefooted rank 1 text and maxRank 3. Forever moved to row2 col1 (Classic row3 col1).

talents.name: Deterrence

ranks.description: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Deterrence effect text and maxRank 1.

talents.name: Counterattack

ranks.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 13 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Counterattack rank 1 text and maxRank 1. Forever moved to row3 col2 (Classic row4 col2).

talents.name: Predator's Edge

ranks.description: Increases your melee critical strike damage by 6% and your offhand weapon damage by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match.

talents.name: Survival Tactics

ranks.description: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 5%.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Conceptually overlaps Trap Mastery / Improved Feign Death.

talents.name: Resourcefulness

ranks.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Trap abilities and melee abilities by 30%. In addition, your critical strikes have a 30% chance to allow 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.

talents.iconHint: Scroll / stone; overview 2/2; arrow to Lacerating Strikes
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match.

talents.name: Expose Prey

ranks.description: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 5% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 5 sec.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match (not Expose Weakness).

talents.name: Survivalist's Discipline

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 20%.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match.

talents.name: Strider Kick

ranks.description: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes

ranks.description: Increases your Agility by 2%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Lightning Reflexes rank 1 (+2% Agility) and maxRank 5.

talents.name: Lacerating Strikes

ranks.description: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage over 21 sec equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Capstone under Resourcefulness arrow (replaces Wyvern Sting slot).

talents.name: Hawk Eye

ranks.description: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 2 yards.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Hawk Eye rank 1 (+2 yd) and maxRank 3. Forever moved to row2 col1 (Classic row2 col3).

talents.name: Improved Concussive Shot

ranks.description: Gives your Concussive Shot a 4% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Improved Concussive Shot rank 1 text and maxRank 5. Forever moved to row0 col0 (Classic row0 col1).

talents.name: Lethal Attacks

ranks.description: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.

talents.diffNotes: Renamed from Lethal Shots; Forever applies to all attacks (Classic was ranged weapons only).

talents.name: Careful Aim

ranks.description: Increases your Attack Power by 20% of your Intellect.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Tier-1 Forever talent; overview shows 3/5 spent.

talents.name: Efficiency

ranks.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 3%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic was 2% on Shots and Stings only; Forever is 3% and includes melee abilities. Forever moved to row0 col1 (Classic row0 col2).

talents.name: Improved Stings

ranks.description: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 6%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 2 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 15 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Combined Forever sting talent (not Classic Improved Serpent Sting / Improved Scorpid Sting separately). Placed at row2 col3 on overview.

talents.name: Rapid Killing

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 1 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match.

talents.name: Rapid Recuperation

ranks.description: Hitting a target with your Serpent Sting ability grants you 25% and consuming Rapid Killing grants you 50% of your Mana regeneration while casting for the next 15 sec.

talents.iconHint: Recuperation icon under Rapid Killing chain
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Placed under Rapid Killing from tooltip dependency arrow.

talents.name: Trueshot Aura

ranks.description: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yards by 30. Lasts 30 min.

talents.diffNotes: Classic foundation grants +50 attack power; Forever tooltip is +30 Ranged Attack Power.

talents.name: Improved Arcane Shot

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 0.3 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 was -0.2 sec; Forever is -0.3 sec and mentions shared-cooldown exclusion. Forever moved to row1 col2 (Classic row2 col1).

talents.name: Lone Wolf

ranks.description: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

talents.iconHint: Wolf head; overview orb at MM right edge
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Crop sits at MM/Survival boundary beside Clever Traps; overview places orb at row4 col3.

talents.name: Mortal Shots

ranks.description: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 6%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic referenced ranged weapon crit damage; Forever says all ranged abilities.

talents.name: Barrage

ranks.description: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 3%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 was +5% to Multi-Shot and Volley only; Forever is +3% and includes Aimed Shot. Forever moved to row3 col1 (Classic row4 col1).

talents.name: Scatter Shot

ranks.description: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic Scatter Shot effect text; Forever shows 15 yd / 84 mana / 30 sec. Forever moved to row2 col0 (Classic row4 col0).

talents.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization

ranks.description: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 1%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Ranged Weapon Specialization rank 1 and maxRank 5. Forever moved to row4 col2 (Classic row5 col2).

talents.name: Sniper Shot

ranks.description: A steady snipe that increases ranged damage by 160.

talents.iconHint: Rifle / long gun; arrow from Ranged Weapon Specialization
talents.diffNotes: Replaces Aimed Shot naming; Forever +160 ranged damage (Classic Aimed Shot +70) with 4 sec cast / 15 sec cooldown. Overview places under RWS at row5 col2.

talents.name: Deadly Aspects

ranks.description: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, all normal ranged attacks have a 2% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 2% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

talents.iconHint: Hand grasping bird; next to Endurance Training
talents.diffNotes: Renamed/replaced Improved Aspect of the Hawk; Forever covers Hawk and Beast aspects with attack-speed procs (Classic Hawk-only 1% chance).

talents.name: Endurance Training

ranks.description: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 3%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 was Health only (+3%); Forever also increases Armor by 3%.

talents.name: Pathfinding

ranks.description: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 3%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Pathfinding rank 1 text and maxRank 2. Forever overview moves it off Classic row2 col0 into tier-2.

talents.name: Improved Revive Pet

ranks.description: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 3 sec, mana cost is reduced by 20%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 15%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Improved Revive Pet rank 1 text and maxRank 2.

talents.name: Focused Fire

ranks.description: Increases all damage you deal by 1% while your pet is active.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match.

talents.name: Bestial Swiftness

ranks.description: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic specified outdoor movement speed; Forever says movement speed of pets (no outdoor restriction in tooltip).

talents.name: Unleashed Fury

ranks.description: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 3%.

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 was +4% pet damage only; Forever is +3% to pets and hawks.

talents.name: Summon Hawk

ranks.description: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 54 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. New Forever BM active.

talents.name: Bestial Discipline

ranks.description: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 10% and allows 25% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.diffNotes: Classic was Focus regeneration only; Forever also grants partial mana regen while casting.

talents.name: Spirit Bond

ranks.description: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 10 sec.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Spirit Bond rank 1 text and maxRank 2. Forever moved to row3 col3 (Classic row4 col0).

talents.name: Intimidation

ranks.description: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

talents.diffNotes: Classic intimidate text differs; Forever is a 3 sec Stun with 100% crit chance and high threat.

talents.name: Frenzy

ranks.description: Gives your pet a 20% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Frenzy rank 1 text and maxRank 5.

talents.name: Bestial Wrath

ranks.description: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

talents.diffNotes: Matches talents.json Bestial Wrath text and maxRank 1.

layoutNotes: Primary layout from hunter/ovvveriview.png (BM 0 / MM 3 / Survival 31 spent). hunter/overview.png is BM-only with Bestial Wrath tooltip.
hunter/1.png–47.png are Hunter Forever tooltips: Survival ~1–18, Marksmanship ~19–35, Beast Mastery ~36–47. hunter/19.png and hunter/35.png are duplicate Sniper Shot shots.

hunter/48.png–70.png verified as Druid Restoration/Feral Combat dumps (e.g. Improved Regrowth, Improved Tranquility, Natural Reaction, Ferocity Maul/Mangle) — listed unmatched; no Hunter text invented from them.
overview part.png / overviewpartt2.png / brave_* dumps were not present in public/hunter at rewrite time (prior notes flagged some as Druid).

Rows/cols are 0-indexed on a 4×7 grid. Survival placement guided by the spent 31-point overview build. MM Improved Stings at row2 col3; Lone Wolf at row4 col3; Sniper Shot under RWS at row5 col2; Rapid Recuperation under Rapid Killing at row5 col0.
Only rank-0 hover text captured (rank-1 effect preview). Higher-rank Forever scaling not shown.
BM overview slots without tooltips: row1 col2 (Thick Hide icon likely), row3 col2 (Ferocity icon likely). MM overview slot without tooltip: row1 col1 (eye — possible Improved Hunter's Mark).
Classic Survival names absent from Forever tree: Monster Slaying, Humanoid Slaying, Trap Mastery, Improved Feign Death, Killer Instinct, Wyvern Sting (slot replaced by Lacerating Strikes).
Merged into talents.json (Hunter only). Forever-new ids 90092–90106. Unnamed occupied BM/MM slots retain Classic Thick Hide, Ferocity, Improved Hunter's Mark.
